items.criterion: An envelope returned by GET /api/messages carries only guid, ciphertext, server_timestamp and group_id, and no row names the sender.
items.judgment: Send sealed, fetch as the recipient device, compare field sets and scan rows for the sender.

items.criterion: A bearer-token send addressed to another account is refused and queues nothing.
items.judgment: Send with a device token to another username and fetch the target queue.

items.criterion: A send whose device set differs from the recipient's active devices is refused whole with ascending missing_devices and extra_devices.
items.judgment: Send short and wide device sets and fetch every device.

items.criterion: Acknowledging an envelope deletes its ciphertext row and leaves the other device's copy.
items.judgment: Acknowledge on one device and scan rows for both ciphertexts.

items.criterion: A resent acknowledged guid is accepted and not delivered again.
items.judgment: Acknowledge, resend the same guid, fetch.

items.criterion: Simultaneous sends of one guid leave one envelope.
items.judgment: Fire six identical sends behind a barrier and count the guid.

items.criterion: A device holds only its newest 1000 envelopes even under simultaneous sends.
items.judgment: Send 1003 then 12 simultaneous envelopes and compare the fetched guids.

items.criterion: Simultaneous bundle fetches never share a one-time pre-key.
items.judgment: Fetch bundles behind a barrier and compare key ids.

items.criterion: The 301st key bundle fetch by a device within sixty seconds is refused.
items.judgment: Fetch 300 bundles, then one more.

items.criterion: Of two simultaneous group changes from one revision exactly one applies and the other returns the current revision.
items.judgment: Patch behind a barrier and read the group.

items.criterion: After ten wrong recovery guesses, including simultaneous ones, the right verifier is refused.
items.judgment: Guess nine, restore, guess twelve at once, restore again.

items.criterion: A second device cannot register without a link code from the same account.
items.judgment: Register without, with a foreign, unknown and used code.

items.criterion: An unlinked device's token is refused and its queued envelopes are deleted.
items.judgment: Unlink, call device endpoints with the old token, scan rows.

items.criterion: Repeating a donation with one Idempotency-Key stores one row.
items.judgment: Repeat sequentially and simultaneously, count rows.

items.criterion: A $25.00 gift is stored as 2500 usd.
items.judgment: Post a gift and read the donations row.

items.criterion: An invalid donation stores nothing.
items.judgment: Post invalid bodies and count rows.

items.criterion: No database row carries a message plaintext after a browser roundtrip.
items.judgment: Send through two browsers and scan every row for the text.

items.criterion: The users row holds a password hash, never the password.
items.judgment: Sign up and scan rows for the password.

items.criterion: An exhausted device still returns a bundle with a null one-time pre-key.
items.judgment: Drain the keys and fetch again.

items.criterion: A non-admin member cannot remove others or change state.
items.judgment: Patch as a non-admin and compare the group.
